plugin.description: PDF 检查、页面编辑、单会话计划与摘要绑定验收；本地候选，宿主和发行证据分别记录。

skills.name: printcraft:printcraft-cli
skills.description: 用户明确要求 PrintCraft 原生 CLI、具体工具、参数 Schema、表单、签名、脱敏或 PDF/A 专项操作时使用；先发现固定版本能力。

interface.shortDescription: Discover native PDF tools and schema contracts
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $printcraft-cli to handle the requested PDF task and verify its artifacts.

skills.name: printcraft:printcraft-cli-automation
skills.description: 用户需要多步 PDF 自动化、单会话文档 ID、任务回执、超时或中断后的只读对账时使用；UNKNOWN 禁止自动重放写入。

interface.shortDescription: Run PDF plans and reconcile uncertain outcomes
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $printcraft-cli-automation to handle the requested PDF task and verify its artifacts.

skills.name: printcraft:printcraft-cli-inspect
skills.description: 用户要求 PDF 元数据、页数、文本、扫描件判断、预览或处理前后检查时使用；空文本只标待 OCR，不误判为空白文档。

interface.shortDescription: Inspect PDF text metadata and page previews
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $printcraft-cli-inspect to handle the requested PDF task and verify its artifacts.

skills.name: printcraft:printcraft-cli-pages
skills.description: 用户要求 PDF 提取、合并、拆分、重排、旋转、裁剪或页框调整时使用；保留原件并逐页核对来源顺序和几何。

interface.shortDescription: Edit PDF pages with order and geometry checks
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $printcraft-cli-pages to handle the requested PDF task and verify its artifacts.

skills.name: printcraft:printcraft-cli-setup
skills.description: PrintCraft 首次安装、缺失运行时、版本或摘要不匹配、离线归档及平台诊断时使用；诊断不写文件，安装与升级分开授权。

interface.shortDescription: Diagnose and install the pinned PDF runtime
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $printcraft-cli-setup to handle the requested PDF task and verify its artifacts.

skills.name: printcraft:printcraft-harness
skills.description: 用户在 PrintCraft 插件内需要多阶段 PDF 编排、任务状态与产物展示、UNKNOWN 对账或定向修订时使用；薄适配上游六项技能和版本化协议，不重写原生执行器。

interface.shortDescription: Route PDF tasks and reconcile execution receipts
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $printcraft-harness to route this PDF task and review its receipts.

skills.name: printcraft:printcraft-use
skills.description: 用户提出一般 PDF 检查、编辑、交付需求但未指定专业入口时使用；按目标路由，登记原件和产物，串联执行与验收。

interface.shortDescription: General PDF task routing and verified delivery
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $printcraft-use to handle the requested PDF task and verify its artifacts.
